flow.flow_name: Create PDF from Two Images (Fixed v2)
flow.description: Uploads two images, combines them into a PDF, and saves it to the user's home folder - avoiding unpacking issues.

data.label: Generate PDF
data.script:
# Use the provided modules and avoid unpacking issues

# Get image data from trigger
image1_info = input.get('image1', {})
image2_info = input.get('image2', {})
image1_data = image1_info.get('data', '')
image2_data = image2_info.get('data', '')

if not image1_data or not image2_data:
    raise ValueError("One or both images are missing")

# Decode image bytes - use the base64_module directly for binary data
img1_bytes = base64_module.b64decode(image1_data)
img2_bytes = base64_module.b64decode(image2_data)

# Create BytesIO objects first
bio1 = io.BytesIO(img1_bytes)
bio2 = io.BytesIO(img2_bytes)

# Access classes from reportlab
ImageReader = reportlab['ImageReader']
Canvas = reportlab['canvas'].Canvas
letter_size = reportlab['pagesizes'].letter

# Create ImageReader objects
img1_reader = ImageReader(bio1)
img2_reader = ImageReader(bio2)

# Create PDF in memory
buffer = io.BytesIO()
c = Canvas(buffer, pagesize=letter_size)

# Get page dimensions
page_width = letter_size[0]
page_height = letter_size[1]
margin = 50
draw_width = page_width - (2 * margin)

# Draw the first image
# Place it near the top of the page
y_pos1 = page_height - margin - 300
c.drawImage(img1_reader, margin, y_pos1, width=draw_width, height=300, preserveAspectRatio=True, anchor='n')

# Draw the second image below the first
# Leave some space between images
y_pos2 = y_pos1 - 350  # 300 for first image + 50 for spacing
c.drawImage(img2_reader, margin, y_pos2, width=draw_width, height=300, preserveAspectRatio=True, anchor='n')

c.showPage()
c.save()

pdf_bytes = buffer.getvalue()
buffer.close()

# Encode PDF to base64 for output
output = {
    'pdf_content': base64_module.b64encode(pdf_bytes).decode('utf-8'),
    'filename': 'combined_images.pdf'
}
